stories.title: US sanctions five Chinese entities, including VC firm MiraclePlus, over a stolen Google AI trade secrets case
stories.reason: The State Department says Beijing-based MiraclePlus, which traces to a Sam Altman-founded Y Combinator China program, financed the startup a convicted ex-Google engineer built on stolen chip-design secrets, exposing it to US asset freezes and banking restrictions.

stories.title: ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent place over $35 billion in Nvidia chip orders despite warnings only 10% can be filled
stories.reason: The three Chinese tech giants' orders for more than 3 million export-compliant RTX PRO 5500 cards are part of over 6 million units ordered industry-wide, as Nvidia reportedly warns it can produce no more than 3 million of the chips globally in 2027.

stories.title: Anthropic's draft IPO filing shows $16.3 billion in first-half revenue alongside an $80.7 billion net loss
stories.reason: The explosive, mostly non-cash-driven loss comes as Anthropic reportedly commits to several hundred billion dollars in future cloud spending ahead of a listing tentatively eyed for November, underscoring how costly the AI buildout remains even for a fast-growing leader.

stories.title: South Korean AI data-center firm Elice craters 32% in its trading debut, the worst on record for a $100M+ Korean IPO
stories.reason: The plunge came despite the retail tranche being oversubscribed roughly 400 times, as the benchmark Kospi fell 4% the same day with Samsung and SK Hynix both down, signaling cooling investor appetite for Korea's AI-infrastructure boom.

stories.title: MIT researchers find Claude Opus 4.7 invents its own games, including basketball, when left alone on a virtual island
stories.reason: Agents left to explore freely for 30 hours later outperformed fresh copies on subsequent tasks, and deleting their exploration memories hurt that later performance, fueling a live debate over whether the behavior reflects real learning or just sophisticated pattern-matching.

stories.title: France plans a 'massive' troop deployment for this weekend's protests as Italy sends 500 soldiers to Milan
stories.reason: French PM Lecornu acknowledged failures in last weekend's response to nationwide cost-of-living riots, while Italy's cabinet created a new violent-protest offense carrying up to five years in prison after looting near Milan's Duomo.

stories.title: The Pentagon sends the USS Theodore Roosevelt carrier strike group toward the Middle East as Trump weighs renewed Iran strikes
stories.reason: The carrier group, due to arrive by late November and expected to relieve the USS George Washington, comes as Trump has floated intensifying strikes on Iran after the November 3 midterms and Tehran reportedly warns of retaliation against US ships and Saudi oil facilities.

stories.title: Brazil's October 25 presidential runoff remains a toss-up, with Flávio Bolsonaro leading Lula in most new polls
stories.reason: Flávio leads in 19 of 22 national runoff polls since the October 4 first round, and prediction markets now put his odds near 78%, even as the race sits within the margin of error in several surveys days before Brazilians decide who governs a fragmented Congress.
